name: InteLogix (Partner)
desc:
Customer Service Representative  | $15/hr | Full-Time, Inbound Calls, No Sales Expected
Company: InteLogix
Industry: Customer Service

What a typical day will look like:
You work from home and are the first point of contact for customers calling in. You answer questions, solve problems, and walk people through solutions. You learn the products, services, and policies so you can help accurately, and you document every call and transaction in the company's tools and platforms. You work with other departments to fix customer issues and pass up the tough ones when needed. You also look for ways to make the customer experience better and keep up with your satisfaction goals and performance numbers. You need to stay on the phone for your whole shift with few distractions, and you may need to work weekends and holidays.

Soft Skills
- Clear phone communication
- Problem solving
- Empathy and patience
- Focus and attendance
- Adaptability
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: At least 6 months of call center experience
Preferred Experience: None listed

Required Skills:
- 18 years old or older
- Strong typing skills
- Microsoft Office and Salesforce
- Troubleshooting basic technical issues
- Able to stay on the phone for the whole shift with minimal distractions, mostly sitting
- Comfortable using multiple windows and tabs while talking to customers
- Superb attendance
- Flexible for weekends and holidays

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has 6 months or more of call center experience
- Types fast and is comfortable with Microsoft Office or Salesforce
- Wants a full-time, non-seasonal job with paid training
- Can be flexible with weekends and holidays

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no call center experience
- Cannot work weekends or holidays when needed
- Has trouble staying focused on calls all day
- Has attendance problems
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or emailed directly to you
3. If the assessment is passing, watch for an email or text from a recruiter for a phone screen
4. If the phone screen goes well, expect a final interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 resume keywords:
- Customer service
- Call center
- Inbound call handling
- Salesforce
- Microsoft Office
- Typing speed
- Troubleshooting
- Documentation
- Multitasking
- Attendance and reliability

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell me about your call center experience.
- How do you stay focused and accurate when you are on the phone all day?
- Tell me about a time you helped an upset customer. What was the problem, what action did you take, and what was the result?
- Tell me about a time you had to learn a new system quickly. What was the problem, what action did you take, and what was the result?
- How do you feel about working weekends or holidays when the work is busy?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:

-Pay: $15/hr.

-Shift: Full-time, non-seasonal. Hours are not listed. The posting says you need flexibility for weekends and holidays within the hours of operation.

-Benefits: Paid training, medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, employee discounts, and career advancement.

-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting.

-Felony Friendly? Case by case.

-Drug Test: Certain positions. The posting does not mention a drug test.

-Notes: Fully remote, and Oklahoma is listed as an eligible location. At least 6 months of call center experience is required, so this is a step up from a brand new customer service role. Strong typing skills and Salesforce experience are listed. Paid training is listed, but the length is not stated. Camera requirements are not listed.

-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Team Lead → Contact Center Supervisor → Contact Center Operations Manager. This role builds call handling, Salesforce, documentation, and customer problem solving skills.
